claims.head: A shadow job for Jenner, Wilson and Protas
claims.call: The Capitals’ L2 (Jenner, Wilson and Protas) spends at least 57% of its 5-on-5 time against the Kings’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Capitals keep sending Wilson’s line (Jenner, Wilson and Protas) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Spencer Carbery has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Kings’ first line is Kempe, Panarin and Byfield.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 3 of their last 5 games, including the last one. Corey Perry takes shifts on two lines, L2 and L4. Joel Edmundson is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Doughty and Ceci.
Kevin Fiala is on injured reserve (lower-leg surgery) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Alex Turcotte is on injured reserve and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Mats Zuccarello is out and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward.
Jared Wright was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Joel Armia and Scott Laughton.
Quinton Byfield is no longer killing penalties: 5% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, down from 43% last season.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 8 games cover only 27% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the second-lowest in the league (a typical team: 45%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Pierre-Luc Dubois is on injured reserve (illness) and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-six forward. Dylan Strome has taken his spot beside Tom Wilson and Alex Tuch.
Rasmus Sandin is out long term (acl surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Vincent Desharnais has taken his spot beside Martin Fehérváry.
Justin Holl was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Cole Hutson.
Jakob Chychrun has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 8% last season.

WSH.head: Nothing to separate these two
WSH.body: Los Angeles has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, while Washington will be without Sourdif. Then again, Washington has home-ice advantage, and Los Angeles will be without Fiala. For the Capitals, the difference could be keeping dangerous shots away.

items.text: Alex Tuch has six goals in six games against Los Angeles since 2023-24, most of them with Buffalo.
The Kings are newly without Alex Turcotte and Mats Zuccarello, and have had to make do without Kevin Fiala all season.
The Capitals have been without Pierre-Luc Dubois since Oct 9, and have had to make do without Rasmus Sandin all season.
Alex Ovechkin is two assists from passing Nicklas Bäckström for first on the Capitals’ all-time assists list.
